items.title: How the GNIS Lake Ontario/Lake America name change in the U.S. will appear in Maps
items.content: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States. Since we update Google Maps …
items.contentSnippet: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has formally changed the name for "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" in the United States. Since we update Google Maps …

summaries.zh: 美国地理名称信息系统（GNIS）正式将“安大略湖”更名为“美洲湖”。该变更将在美国地图上体现，包括谷歌地图等平台。此次更名涉及湖泊名称的官方记录更新，后续地图服务将同步调整。
summaries.en: The U.S. Geographic Names Information System (GNIS) has officially renamed "Lake Ontario" to "Lake America" within the U.S. This change will be reflected in updated maps, including Google Maps. The decision aligns with the GNIS's role in standardizing geographic names in the country. The renaming affects only the U.S. designation, as Lake Ontario remains officially named in Canada. The update is part of GNIS's ongoing efforts to maintain accurate geographic data.

items.summary: 美国地理名称信息系统（GNIS）正式将“安大略湖”更名为“美洲湖”。该变更将在美国地图上体现，包括谷歌地图等平台。此次更名涉及湖泊名称的官方记录更新，后续地图服务将同步调整。
